summary: FoodCoopShop is an open-source web application designed to help community-supported agriculture groups and food cooperatives manage their operations. It provides a platform to handle member orders, coordinate product distribution, and facilitate the collective purchasing of local goods. The software is written in PHP and distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for small food cooperatives or buying groups that need a dedicated, self-hosted platform to coordinate orders and members.
watchOut: The project has a moderate maintenance tempo and relatively low adoption compared to broader e-commerce alternatives, which might mean you will rely more heavily on community support or self-troubleshooting.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, you will typically need to run it behind a web server with a PHP runtime and a separate database backend, though containerisation via Docker can simplify setting up the environment and persistent volumes.
